# LLM Usage Policy for This Repository

## Access
Crawling: Disallowed
Indexing: Disallowed
Archiving: Disallowed

## Training
Training: Prohibited
Fine-tuning: Prohibited
Embedding generation: Prohibited
Dataset inclusion: Prohibited
Derivative model creation: Prohibited

## Commercial Use
Commercial training: Prohibited
Commercial redistribution: Prohibited

## Attribution
Quoted excerpts: Permitted
Citation with attribution: Permitted
Non-automated academic referencing: Permitted

## Conditions
- Attribution must clearly reference the original source URL.
- Content may not be stored in vector databases or retrieval systems.
- Content may not be used for model evaluation or benchmarking.

## Contact
For inquiries contact: saxens17@mcmaster.ca
